lens: Skeptic, final confirmation on head ced028f (the w11-rated fabric tiles plus later non-fabric fixes). Official ANA photos y_47300-07 set colours; sans_* and fr57325_* set geometry. Renders: /tmp/claude-0/rF q15-q18 and studio e1-e9. I took the measurements with PIL/numpy/scipy on matched crops (L50, p90/p50, p10/p50, mean colour, B/R, and a low-variance mask for the cover extent). Scripts and a contact sheet are in /tmp/claude-0/raterAF/ (m.py, g.py, studio_sheet.png). I used the same calibration as w11a/w13a. Camera placement (q15 is about 0.3 m too high, and q16/q17 do not match their reference viewpoints) and lighting are noted, not scored.

details.evidence: q15 front-row tick backs: p90/p50 1.30-1.45 against y_47300 1.48, and p10/p50 0.63-0.73 against 0.49-0.50. The weave ground is too shallow, while the strokes are grey-white vertical dashes ('digital rain' in e4 middle, e7 pans and q16 near). The photo shows small lavender-blue chevron ticks. Colour is close: #3c4970, B/R 1.86, against #36436c-#495b8b, B/R 1.89-1.99.

e1 left and the q15/q16 headrest pads show a regular rounded quatrefoil grid. y_47306 left has larger, lower-contrast pointed star/diamond chains. This is the w11 tile, which beat the w13 violet overcorrection.

q15 seat 4: p90/p50 1.72 against y_47300 seat 4 1.76 (good), but p10/p50 0.84 against 0.68, so the ground is too flat. Close up (q16 near pads, e4 left pad) the flecks are large near-white confetti, where the y_47301 near-pad specks are small and light blue.
e4 right seat and e1 pans: a blocky speckle. y_47306 right shows crisp near-white horizontal dashes on a deep navy ground, with blocks visible only as density changes. Same issue as w11a-2.

q15 front-row backs read tick, tick, tick, fleck; y_47300 is tick, fleck, tick, fleck. q16 still reads as fleck snow plus diamond pads. The variety is plausible, and the family colour is consistent (back B/R 1.86-2.18 against 1.89-2.32).

Head-on in q15, cover/back luminance is 0.81/0.84/0.92/1.00 against y_47300 0.68/0.86/0.54/0.72, so the covers are still too bright at seats 3 and 4. The cover is a flat matte plate: p90/p50 1.07 against 1.03-1.20, with no top fold lip, stitched border or wing logo (y_47306). Head-on, the cover is 0.65 of the back width and h/w 0.90; y_47300 gives 0.50 and 0.69. That may be partly the headrest height setting, since y_47306 at 3/4 view matches better.
e4b and e1: navy, correctly sized and flat. It is untextured, with soft squircle corners rather than the pinched ears in y_47300.

e7 and e1: a straight box on a vertical post with a knuckle. y_47300 and y_47303 show a slender arm that slopes down toward the front and joins the spreader with a J curve. The render is also whiter than the warm light grey in the photos.
e7 and e1: teal-blue webbing with a silver buckle, matching y_47303.

e7 pan: #394678, B/R 2.10, L50 75, against y_47300 pans #3c496e-#4c5b84, B/R 1.74-1.82. Colour is fine, but contrast p90/p50 is 2.0-2.07 against 1.32-1.65: the strokes are too bright and read as a knit.

q15: the crown and rolls are present, but a white hood rim about 1.5 cm wide is still visible across every front-row back top. In y_47300 the fabric runs to the top edge (w13a-3 / w13b-4 not fixed; only the coat-hook knob was lowered).
q17, q18 and e2/e9: an off-white shell with a purple placard band, mesh pocket and tray latch, a good match to y_47303 and sans_15.
q18 against y_47305: handset/bezel width 0.53 against 0.50, with a thick lower bezel. There is no shallow recessed bay around the screen, and the photo's bezel LEDs are missing.
e6 and q18: the card placard, latch, round cup recess, mesh pocket and AC box are present. The pocket ruching is weak.
e8 and q17: the leg, spreader, footrest bar and box are present and plausible against y_47303. The red tags are slightly too saturated.
q15 and q16 far rows: colour and variety are consistent, but the far covers read slightly lighter relative to the fabric than in y_47300.

issues.title: Fabric strokes too bright and grey-white: tick and pan read as digital rain, fleck as confetti snow close up
issues.evidence: Pan p90/p50 2.0 against 1.3-1.65. Tick p10/p50 0.63-0.73 against 0.49 (ground too shallow, strokes too pale). Near-pad flecks are near-white and large (q16).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py: tint the tick and fleck highlights toward light lavender-blue (#92a6df), shorten and slant the tick strokes, deepen the tick channels to p10/p50 about 0.5, and shrink the fleck size by about 30 % while keeping density.

issues.title: White hood rim visible across back tops head-on
issues.evidence: q15: a white rim about 1.5 cm wide over every near-row back. y_47300 shows fabric to the top edge.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: pull the shell cap rows aft/down behind the fabric crown so no shell shows from the y_47300 eye.

issues.title: Dash mosaic and diamond tiles do not match the official weave
issues.evidence: The mosaic is a blocky speckle, not crisp whitish dash rows on deep navy (y_47306 right). The diamond is a rounded uniform quatrefoil grid, not pointed star chains (y_47306 left).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic: continuous whitish dashes, about 2 mm row spacing, dark-quartile ground near #0d1b4b. y_diamond: pointed, stepped-edge figures with irregular chain spacing and lower saturation.

issues.title: Headrest covers too bright head-on and lack leatherette detail
issues.evidence: Cover/back 0.81-1.00 against 0.54-0.86. The plate is flat, with no fold lip, stitched border or logo.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover darker and rougher (#31364f, r 0.70). Add a 6 mm top lip and a stitch line 1 cm in from the edge.

issues.title: Armrests are boxy on a vertical post
issues.fix: Loft the arm on a 3-point spline that slopes toward the front and tapers, with a J-curved support into the spreader. Use a warm light grey.

issues.title: Fabric mix leans tick in q15 and fleck in q16
issues.evidence: q15 front row is tick, tick, tick, fleck; y_47300 is tick, fleck, tick, fleck.
issues.fix: econFab: alternate tick and fleck on backs, and keep diamond and mosaic as minority variants.

issues.title: Pillow untextured, no pinched corners; screen has no recessed bay
issues.evidence: e4b against y_47300; q18 against y_47305.
issues.fix: Pull the pillow corners out and add a fine weave layer. Add a 6 mm sloped frame ring round the bezel.

issues.title: (Not econ) Camera mismatch
issues.evidence: q15 is about 0.3 m higher than y_47300. q16 and q17 do not reproduce the y_47301 and y_47303 viewpoints.

questionsForUser: Do you have your own close-up photo of the Y fabrics (tick, mosaic and diamond) at 1:1 scale? The official photos are too small to cut a faithful mosaic or diamond tile.
Should the headrests be modelled in the lowered position seen in y_47300, or the raised position seen in y_47306?
